# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VOLUME_BREAK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A strong volume surge in the first 30 minutes with price above VWAP signals institutional buying bias for the day. This captures early-session momentum driven by smart money participation, which often persists through the session when not overridden by macro events.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If the 30‑minute bar (09:30‑10:00) has volume > 1.5 × the average 30‑minute volume of the prior 10 days AND its close > VWAP(30) AND close > open, enter long at the bar's close. Exit shape: Initial stop at the lower of the 30‑minute bar's low or VWAP − 0.5×ATR(14); target at 1.5R or trail stop 12% above the highest close since entry. Regime hint: Works best when VIX < 20 and ADX < 22 (non‑trendy); avoid during FOMC windows or major news (first 15 min after 09:30 if gap >0.3%).
